In detail

The large residential district east of the centre. Three of the locations named in the city's policing documents are here — Trnavské mýto, Dulovo námestie and the 500-bytov estate — and they are the ordinary kind of urban problem spot rather than anywhere a visitor would be. Much of Ružinov is unremarkable low-rise housing and parkland.

This specific area was reviewed against credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — and the signals were consolidated across sources rather than taken from any single report, with the reasoning and the sources shown above. Bratislava publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does publish one, Wandroz uses it instead of an assessment. Where a review finds nothing documented, that is recorded as no findings rather than as a safety rating.

Frequently asked questions

Is Ružinov safe?

Wandroz currently rates Ružinov in Bratislava as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Bratislava during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Bratislava at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. Bratislava publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does, Wandroz uses it instead.

Is Ružinov safe at night?

At night, Ružinov is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Bratislava. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Ružinov a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Ružinov's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Bratislava) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. Is there official crime data for Ružinov?

Not an official government crime feed — Ružinov's rating comes from Wandroz's own current local/national press and survey research for this specific area instead (see the note on this page for what was checked and the sources used).
